recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not reintroduce MedicationUsage unless Pharmacy makes a new decision superseding FHIR-38682; preserve the old-type MedicationUsage entry unless terminology policy changes separately.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request for R5 asking to rename MedicationStatement to MedicationUsage because the resource documents medication use and the term statement could be confused with a medication profile.
initial_application: Commit 040377bccb10e55b6158e9ab260883ded1e13b13 applied the rename by changing active source/fhir.ini and source/hierarchy.xml entries from MedicationStatement to MedicationUsage and renaming the MedicationStatement source folder and examples. The Jira application comment points to build commit 014d1416, but 040377bccb is the source-history commit that performs the rename.
additional_context: FHIR-38682 was later Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and explicitly changed MedicationUsage back to MedicationStatement while keeping the other R5 changes. Pharmacy 2022-10-31 minutes record the 11-0-0 motion for that reversal, and commit b2032629f28b8d31b9a67b46170dde873398fb0d applied it across active build configuration, hierarchy, resource source, examples, and cross-references. Existing combined-branch audits for FHIR-24568, FHIR-30582, and FHIR-38873 also rely on FHIR-38682 as the governing later rename-back decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/fhir.ini and source/hierarchy.xml actively build MedicationStatement, no tracked source/medicationusage files remain, and the only current MedicationUsage occurrence is the intentional old-type code in source/terminologies/codesystem-fhir-old-types.xml.
